items.description: The site is Anthropic's developer documentation for the Claude API / Claude Developer Platform; the root platform.claude.com is the Console, which requires login
llms-full.txt with the complete documentation content
Docs MCP server (Streamable HTTP transport) for searching and reading the docs, plus its server card
JSON file listing the latest version of each Anthropic SDK and the ant CLI

Docs are available in English (936 pages, /docs/en) and 11 other languages (de, es, fr, it, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-CN, zh-TW, id) with about 342 pages each under /docs/<lang>; only English content is indexed in the file
Get started / quickstart guide for Claude API
Models overview page comparing Claude models
Pricing page for the Claude API
Messages API reference (Create a Message endpoint)

API reference operation pages (Messages, Batches, Files, Models, Skills, Admin/organization, Compliance, and beta Managed Agents endpoints like sessions, agents, vaults), often in paired GA and Beta versions
Tool use guides covering defining and handling tools and built-in tools (web search, web fetch, code execution, computer use, bash, memory, text editor)
Build-with-Claude feature guides (prompt caching, extended/preserved thinking, streaming, batch processing, structured outputs, vision, compaction, citations)
Claude Managed Agents docs (hosted and self-hosted agent sessions, environments, vaults, memory, webhooks)
SDK and CLI docs per language (Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, Ruby, PHP, C#) and the ant CLI
Per-model overview pages and per-model system prompt release notes, plus migration guides and deprecations
